lines.text: @maya_front dives off a wooden jetty into a still lake, and the ripples spread to the far shore.
Hold on the ripples after she is gone.

new_beats.text: A heron lifts from the reeds on the far shore.

writes.note: I added a beat where a heron lifts from the far shore as the ripples reach it.

reply.rationale: The shot lacked a reaction from the landscape; a heron taking off gives the ripples a visible arrival without changing the existing words.
